按 143/f 计算长度，接巴伦，测驻波修剪: Size it with 143/f, add a balun, trim while watching SWR
磁环绕 8–12 圈同轴/双线，抑制共模: 8–12 turns of coax/twin-lead on a toroid to choke common mode
高压电容 + 粗管环形，注意耐压: High-voltage capacitor + thick-tube loop; mind the voltage rating
电视棒 + 上变频器，配合 SDR 软件: TV dongle + upconverter, driven by SDR software
LC 并联谐振，抑制本地强台: Parallel LC resonance to notch a local strong station
2 根，各 1/4 波长 + 修剪余量: 2 pieces, each 1/4 wave plus trimming allowance
可自制（见巴伦项目）: Can be home-brewed (see the balun project)
接上馈线后测驻波比，谐振点应接近设计频率。: Connect the feedline and measure SWR; resonance should sit near the design frequency.
谐振点偏低（频率低）→ 修剪缩短振子；两边同时修剪保持对称。: Resonance too low (lower in frequency) → trim the elements shorter, both sides equally.
万用表测通断与绝缘：输入输出各自导通，对外壳绝缘。: Check continuity and insulation with a multimeter: in/out each conduct, both insulated from the case.
输出接假负载，输入端看驻波应接近 1:1。: With a dummy load on the output, SWR at the input should be near 1:1.
用 VNA 看谐振与驻波，电容调谐范围应覆盖目标频段。: With a VNA check resonance and SWR; the capacitor's tuning range must cover the band.
先用小功率试发，确认无异常再逐步加大，观察电容与连接点是否打火；发射时人体与环体: Start with low power and raise it step by step, watching for arcing at the capacitor and joints; keep a safe distance from the loop while transmitting.
装好驱动后用 SDR 软件收到本地 FM 广播即算通。: Once the driver works, receiving a local FM station in SDR software means success.
再试业余段信号（144 / 430 MHz 中继等）。: Then try amateur signals (144 / 430 MHz repeaters etc.).
按键输出正确的点划与间隔。: The button produces correct dots, dashes and spacing.
换用电键接口再测一遍。: Test again through the key jack.
用 VNA 看陷波频率与深度。: With a VNA check notch frequency and depth.
装到振子上，验证对目标频段的抑制。: Fit it to the element and verify the suppression on the target band.
高度不足时谐振点整体偏移，先固定架设高度再修剪。: Resonance shifts when the antenna is low; fix the height before trimming.
修剪过头无法加长 —— 下料时留足余量。: You cannot un-trim; leave plenty of allowance when cutting.
馈线外皮也是辐射体的一部分，巴伦不可省。: The feedline's outer surface is part of the radiator — do not skip the balun.
磁环碎裂会明显改变性能，固定螺丝别上太紧。: A cracked toroid changes performance noticeably; do not overtighten.
大功率连续发射时留意磁环饱和发烫。: At high power the toroid can saturate and heat up.
双线并绕别绞得太紧，容易伤漆皮造成短路。: Do not twist bifilar windings too tightly or the enamel may break.
谐振带宽很窄，换频段要重新调谐。: The resonant bandwidth is narrow; retune when changing bands.
电容耐压不够会打火，按发射功率选耐压。: Insufficient voltage rating arcs; size it for the power level.
环体电阻大则效率剧降，压接点必须接触良好。: Loop resistance kills efficiency; joints must be solid.
早期批次晶振频偏明显，先预热几分钟再校频。: Early batches drift; warm up for a few minutes before calibrating.
直采收不到 HF，需要上变频器。: Direct sampling cannot reach HF; add an upconverter.
前端容易过载，强信号环境降低增益。: The front end overloads easily; reduce gain around strong signals.
点划比例与间隔由程序控制，先用默认节拍练。: Dot/dash ratio and spacing come from the code; practise at the default speed first.
蜂鸣器音量可以串一只电位器调节。: Add a potentiometer in series to adjust the buzzer volume.
电容耐压与损耗直接决定能承受的功率。: Voltage rating and loss set the power the trap can take.
陷波深度与带宽是权衡，别一味求深。: Notch depth trades against bandwidth; do not chase depth alone.
装进外壳后参数会漂，先粗调再细调。: Parameters shift once boxed; rough-tune first, then fine-tune.
从天线 / 巴伦等低门槛项目入手，备齐工具与材料。: Start with low-threshold items like antennas and baluns; gather tools and parts.
用站内计算器（天线长度、LC 谐振、巴伦匝数）确定尺寸。: Use the on-site calculators (antenna length, LC resonance, balun turns).
按图施工，焊接 / 压接牢固，留好调试余量。: Build to the drawing, solder/crimp solidly and leave tuning margin.
用驻波表 / 天线分析仪 / VNA 测量，逐步调整。: Measure with an SWR meter / antenna analyser / VNA and adjust step by step.
记录尺寸与结果，形成可复现的制作笔记。: Record dimensions and results into reproducible build notes.
高处架设天线注意防坠落与防雷，雷雨天停止操作。: When erecting antennas aloft mind falls and lightning; stop in thunderstorms.
发射前确认天线驻波与匹配，避免损坏功放。: Confirm antenna SWR and matching before transmitting to protect the amplifier.
电容储能与高压电路注意放电后再触碰。: Discharge stored energy in capacitors and HV circuits before touching them.
遵守当地法规，控制发射功率与频段。: Follow local regulations on power and bands.
